UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location 'loki'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'server','data' | Out-Null; $v = '{{ServerVersion}}'; if (-not $v) { $v = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing 'https://api.github.com/repos/grafana/loki/releases/latest').tag_name }; if ($v -notmatch '^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.]+)?$') { Write-Output ('Invalid Loki version format specified: ' + $v); exit 1 }; $n = $v.Substring(1); if ((Test-Path 'server/loki.exe') -and (Test-Path 'server/.installed-version') -and ((Get-Content 'server/.installed-version' -Raw).Trim() -eq $n)) { Write-Output ('Loki ' + $v + ' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -OutFile 'loki.zip' ('https://github.com/grafana/loki/releases/download/' + $v + '/loki-windows-amd64.exe.zip') } catch { Remove-Item 'loki.zip' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'Download failed from GitHub. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if (Test-Path 'extract') { Remove-Item 'extract' -Recurse -Force }; Expand-Archive -Path 'loki.zip' -DestinationPath 'extract' -Force; Move-Item -Path 'extract/loki-windows-amd64.exe' -Destination 'server/loki.exe' -Force; Remove-Item 'extract','loki.zip' -Recurse -Force; Set-Content -Path 'server/.installed-version' -Value $n; Write-Output ('Loki ' + $v + ' installed')"

-c "ServerVersion=\"{{ServerVersion}}\"; Arch=\"amd64\"; cd loki || exit 1; mkdir -p server data; if [[ -z \"$ServerVersion\" ]]; then ServerVersion=$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/grafana/loki/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name); fi; if [[ ! \"$ServerVersion\" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.]+)?$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Loki version format specified: $ServerVersion\"; exit 1; fi; Version=\"${ServerVersion#v}\"; if [[ -x server/loki && \"$(cat server/.installed-version 2>/dev/null)\" == \"$Version\" ]]; then echo \"Loki $ServerVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0; fi; rm -f loki.zip; wget -qO loki.zip \"https://github.com/grafana/loki/releases/download/$ServerVersion/loki-linux-$Arch.zip\" || { rm -f loki.zip; echo \"Download failed from GitHub. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; unzip -o -q loki.zip -d server && mv -f \"server/loki-linux-$Arch\" server/loki && rm -f loki.zip && chmod +x server/loki && echo \"$Version\" > server/.installed-version && echo \"Loki $ServerVersion installed\""

-c "ServerVersion=\"{{ServerVersion}}\"; Arch=\"arm64\"; cd loki || exit 1; mkdir -p server data; if [[ -z \"$ServerVersion\" ]]; then ServerVersion=$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/grafana/loki/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name); fi; if [[ ! \"$ServerVersion\" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.]+)?$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Loki version format specified: $ServerVersion\"; exit 1; fi; Version=\"${ServerVersion#v}\"; if [[ -x server/loki && \"$(cat server/.installed-version 2>/dev/null)\" == \"$Version\" ]]; then echo \"Loki $ServerVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0; fi; rm -f loki.zip; wget -qO loki.zip \"https://github.com/grafana/loki/releases/download/$ServerVersion/loki-linux-$Arch.zip\" || { rm -f loki.zip; echo \"Download failed from GitHub. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; unzip -o -q loki.zip -d server && mv -f \"server/loki-linux-$Arch\" server/loki && rm -f loki.zip && chmod +x server/loki && echo \"$Version\" > server/.installed-version && echo \"Loki $ServerVersion installed\""
